segments.name: North America Regions
segments.description: Delivers energy efficiency, renewable energy and O&M projects to governments, utilities, institutions and commercial customers across North America.
segments.evidence: Our reportable segments for the year ended December 31, 2024 were North America Regions, U.S. Federal, Europe, and Renewable Fuels (formerly Alternative Fuels).

segments.name: U.S. Federal
segments.description: Delivers energy efficiency, renewable and O&M projects to the U.S. federal government, which is treated as a single customer.
segments.evidence: Revenues from the U.S. federal government are included in our U.S. Federal segment.

segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Delivers energy projects to customers across Europe, including active projects in the United Kingdom.
segments.evidence: Our reportable segments for the year ended December 31, 2024 were North America Regions, U.S. Federal, Europe, and Renewable Fuels (formerly Alternative Fuels).

segments.name: Renewable Fuels
segments.description: Develops and operates biogas facilities that produce renewable natural gas, electricity and thermal energy for sale.
segments.evidence: Our reportable segments for the year ended December 31, 2024 were North America Regions, U.S. Federal, Europe, and Renewable Fuels (formerly Alternative Fuels).

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Offers consulting services and sells solar PV energy products and systems, called integrated-PV.
segments.evidence: The "All Other" category offers consulting services and the sale of solar PV energy products and systems which we refer to as integrated-PV.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for energy efficiency and renewable energy projects, multi-year operations and maintenance contracts, and energy sold under contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: After a project is complete, we may operate, maintain and repair the customer's energy systems under a multi-year O&M contract, designed to provide us with recurring revenue and visibility into the customer's evolving needs.

changes.text: In 2024, Renewable Fuels was renamed from Alternative Fuels.
changes.evidence: Our reportable segments for the year ended December 31, 2024 were North America Regions, U.S. Federal, Europe, and Renewable Fuels (formerly Alternative Fuels).

changes.text: In 2024, U.S. Regions and Canada were moved into the North America Regions segment.
changes.evidence: On January 1, 2024, we changed the structure of our internal organization, and our U.S. Regions and Canada are now included in North America Regions.

changes.text: In 2024, the company sold a business, which was reported within All Other.
changes.evidence: On December 31, 2024, we completed the sale of a business.
